sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a compact runbook snippet for cache-hotkey incidents plus clear owners for follow-ups. Dropping a draft here.

alix: paste it pls

sam: Draft runbook snippet (to add to cookbook):
- Verify signals: run PromQL for evictions and check redis INFO memory.
- Short mitigation: enable read-only mode for nonessential traffic or shift to mid-tier fallback.
- Fix: identify hot prefixes, apply prefix-based TTLs or light sharding, roll via canary.
- Canary guidance: 5% traffic for 30m, monitor evictions and p95 latency; rollback criteria = evictions increase >10% or p95 regress >200ms vs baseline.
- Postmortem follow-up: add a synthetic hotkey test to staging CI and update escalation thresholds.

sam: Snippets/commands to include verbatim:
```bash
# promql: evictions rate
sum(rate(redis_evicted_keys_total[1m]))
# redis memory and evictions
redis-cli INFO memory | egrep "used_memory_human|evicted_keys"
# approximate top keys (scan + memory usage)
redis-cli --scan | xargs -n1 -P8 redis-cli MEMORY USAGE | sort -nr | head -n 20
# k8s quick checks
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=cache -o wide; kubectl describe pod <pod> | egrep "OOMKilled|RestartCount"
```

mira: I'll own the cookbook PR and add the canary wording + notification templates. ETA Thu EOD.

jordan: I'll own the staging synthetic test and add a load job to reproducibly trigger a hot prefix. ETA next Mon.

alix: For escalation, propose: if evicted_keys > 0 AND p95 latency > 250ms for 5m -> page infra lead and eng-sre. I'll add the contact list and a Slack template. ETA Fri.

sam: Summary owners: cookbook PR = mira (due 2026-04-09), CI test = jordan (due 2026-04-13), escalation matrix = alix (due 2026-04-10). ops-bot, please queue a 7-day check-in.
